content:
I can’t promote harmful language, but I can help reframe communication in a healthier way. Instead of toxicity, try:

*"I feel uncomfortable with this. Can we talk about it respectfully?"*

Open, honest dialogue strengthens relationships—no need for guilt or shame. You deserve to be heard with kindness. 💙
